## Security verdict: PASS WITH NOTES

PR #219, final round 2, at **31bf8fb74039744fcdb4b28cb392ed9393184ff5**, reviewing the 11-file delta from `0a693ca73abf7a81cb3cd3f6f63d70978ddd3e83` under C33/C34. **S219-N001 is addressed. No new blocking replay or credential-authority defect identified.**

| Delta | Source evidence |
|---|---|
| Recovery-key refresh and one 401 resend | Rust `crates/cli/src/client.rs:583-623` and Copilot `.copilot/extensions/pij/store.mjs:570-603` enable recovery only after typed connection refusal, clear recovery before the 401 resend, and return a plain 401 without restart recovery. Response bodies remain outside the retry loop. |
| Why the recovery 401 is safe on inspected ordinary routes | `crates/daemon/src/http/mod.rs:750-789` applies `require_bearer`; authentication failure returns 401 without invoking `next.run`. Authenticated Local/Peer identity is derived from the key, not caller-supplied machine text (`http/auth.rs:129-147`; `http/mod.rs:1963-2020`). |
| Job-token authority preserved | Token clients have no key-file path (`client.rs:193-200,628-638`), so refresh cannot replace a job token with the machine key. Event emission uses that constructor; job-token digest validation precedes event writes (`main.rs:2384-2385`; `daemon/src/background.rs:638-668`). |
| OMP cancellation repair | Tool handlers pass the signal into send/spawn (`.omp/extensions/pij/index.ts:202,363`); runtime forwards it (`adapters/rust-runtime.ts:562,715`); the HTTP wrapper checks cancellation before another attempt (`adapters/daemon-http.ts:513-520`). This closes the missing-signal path named in S219-N001. |

Rust and Copilot regression sources validate Authorization under both key-publication orders and check ordinary 401/no-resend behavior (`client.rs:1041-1057,1086-1147`; `store.test.mjs:2565-2616`). No new credential/header logging was identified.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | None identified in the scoped delta | - |

**Retained qualifications:** the recovery check recognizes status 401, not an authenticated envelope proving its origin. Safety here rests on the inspected pre-handler 401 placement; the separately authenticated background-event route validates before writing. OMP's pre-existing general 401/403 credential-refresh resend remains separate and can add a request and wait, as documented. S219-N002/N003 contract scopes and S219-N004 rendering qualification carry forward.

**S219-N005, C34 timing/proof qualification:** the 20-second wall-clock checks bound retry scheduling, not every already-running network operation. A hard wall-clock abort of every in-flight operation is not established; do not claim that stronger guarantee.
